scope: Per-call comparison of the usage that Foundry reported (input_tokens, output_tokens) with the per-round prompt_tokens and completion_tokens of the model API records. FP8 profile, 27 successful calls. It holds token counts only. It holds no request text, tool arguments, tool results or answer text.

sources.foundry: The usage field of each Foundry response, saved on the client side in the series file named in each row (calls[call_index - 1].usage).
sources.model_api_rounds: Per-round prompt_tokens and completion_tokens of the model API records. The model API owner read them from private server records and reported them. The records are not in this repository.
sources.matching: The model API owner matched calls and records by request and response times and by the order tool-call round then stop round. Only records in the same window were candidates, and a record was used only when exactly one candidate existed. The client clock is at least 2 s slower than the server clock. The offset was not measured.

rounds_format: Each round is [prompt_tokens, completion_tokens] of one model API record, in call order. Two rounds: the first round returned the tool call and the second round returned the final answer. One round: the model returned the final answer without a tool call (30c-03 and 30c-07).

observed_pattern.reported_by: model API owner (offline comparison, no new calls). The Foundry columns match the usage values in the series files.

excluded.label: 30-01 to 30-12
excluded.reason: The 12 completed calls of the first 30-call window ran before the model API stored per-record logs. The per-round data are unknown, not zero.
Connection error at conversation creation. No usage.

excluded.label: 30b-12
excluded.reason: Connection error at conversation creation. No model API record and no usage.

excluded.label: W2-02
excluded.reason: Web IQ rejected the tool call (HTTP 400, tool_user_error). One model API 200 record exists (first round only). Foundry reported no usage.

excluded.label: 30c-04 first attempt
excluded.reason: One model API 503 record without usage. Only the two 200 records were compared.

excluded.label: D-2 (3 calls) and v2 window (4 calls)

not_determined: Which layer produces the difference of 4 tokens. The data show only the pattern.
Whether the difference of 4 holds for other models, prompts or tool counts. The data cover the FP8 profile, one or two model rounds, and the Learn and Web IQ tools.
Why Foundry reports the input of the last round and not the sum of the rounds.
related_report: In a separate direct test (2 calls with fixed bodies, no Foundry), the model API owner reported usage.prompt_tokens equal to the vLLM counter increase (14 and 1213, difference 0). That test does not involve Foundry.
